title: The Modding Tree
summary: Build a prestige-based incremental game by changing layers, upgrades and progression.
prerequisites: Browser JavaScript; read the getting-started guide.
setupHint: Fork or download the repository, follow docs/tutorials/getting-started.md, then customize layers and upgrades.

title: A Dark Forest
summary: A minimal incremental game inspired by A Dark Room. Study and remix its resource and discovery loops.
prerequisites: Godot; match the version in the upstream project.
setupHint: Open the downloaded project in the matching Godot editor. Follow the upstream setup and asset attribution notes.

title: Deckbuilder Framework
summary: Card drawing, shuffling and deck interactions for your own deckbuilder. A foundation for Balatro-style experiments, not a complete Balatro game.
prerequisites: Godot; a card-game design of your own.
setupHint: Follow the README installation steps; explore the simple, fancy and solitaire examples. Customize CardData and card scenes.

title: Balatro-style Godot prototype
summary: An upstream Balatro clone described as Godot 4.4. Reference candidate only: no license was found, and execution and asset rights have not been verified.
prerequisites: Godot 4.4; source and asset review before reuse.
setupHint: Inspect the source. Resolve reuse permission and replace any proprietary assets before treating this as a reusable starter.

title: Steamodded / SMODS
summary: Extend Balatro with community-made cards and effects. This is a modding framework, not a standalone game engine.
prerequisites: A legitimate Balatro installation and the upstream mod dependencies.
setupHint: Follow the SMODS installation and mod-development guides; this path produces a Balatro mod.

title: Godot demo projects
summary: Official demo projects for platforming, vehicles, UI and other game systems. Choose an individual demo as your base.
prerequisites: Godot version matching the chosen demo branch.
setupHint: Choose a demo subdirectory, download the repository, then import that demo project.godot in the matching editor.

title: Not-Balatro poker foundation
summary: Hackable browser poker-hand engine. Upstream is an engine demo; it does not include a complete campaign or shop.
setupHint: Serve the upstream folder over HTTP.
